dialogue.text: Over thousands of years, Chinese people have constantly observed and learned from nature.
dialogue.zh: 數千年來，中國人不斷觀察並從自然中學習。

dialogue.local: Over thousands of years, Chinese people have constantly observed and learned from nature.
dialogue.en: Over thousands of years, Chinese people have constantly observed and learned from nature.

dialogue.text: They've worked hard to cultivate the land, and it's this self-efficient lifestyle that has led to the Chinese people that we know today.
dialogue.zh: 他們努力耕作土地，這種自給自足的生活方式造就了我們今天所知的中國人。
dialogue.ja: 彼らは土地を一生懸命耕し、この自給自足の生活様式が今日の中国人を作り上げました。

dialogue.text: In China, at the right time, is the most ingenious way for people to get along with nature.

dialogue.ja: 中国では、適切な時期に行うことが自然と共存する最も巧妙な方法です。

dialogue.ja: しかし伝統文化の恩恵を受けつつ、時代の発展に伴い科学技術が非常に重要になっています。

dialogue.en: But the blessings on traditional culture and following the development of the times, science and technology have become all important.

dialogue.en: Since opening up its economy 40 years ago, China has completely transformed.

dialogue.ja: 中国の大都市から離れた襄昌では、大きな変化の気配を感じられます。

dialogue.local: And all of this is a better standard of living.
dialogue.en: And all of this is a better standard of living.

dialogue.text: Walking in the newly planted fields, you can feel the difference. Everything here is constantly changing.
dialogue.zh: 走在新種植的田野裡，你能感受到變化。這裡的一切都在不斷變化。

dialogue.en: Walking in the newly planted fields, you can feel the difference. Everything here is constantly changing.

dialogue.en: Only the same time something has not changed nature carries on regardless.

dialogue.en: As we come to the end of this solar term here in China, it's been a very dramatic one.

dialogue.ja: 私が座っているこの畑はかつて小麦が風に揺れていましたが、今は新しく植えられた作物が育っています。

dialogue.en: These fields that I am sat in were once blowing with wheat are now already newly planted crops.

dialogue.ja: 次の節気までには緑が生い茂り、私は中国での次の旅に出かけます。

dialogue.en: By the next solar term will be green and flourishing and I shall be on my next journey in China.
